description: This file contains unit tests for the 'failover-policy' module, specifically testing the functions 'resolveRunFailoverDecision' and 'mergeRetryFailoverReason'. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework and references internal functions from the same module.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Determines the failover action based on the current stage and context, such as retry limit, prompt, or assistant stage, and whether failover decisions should escalate or fallback.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, prioritizing timeout if no reason is present, else preserving the previous reason.
